name: Manganese diacetate
description: Manganese diacetate (CAS 638-38-0 ), also known as manganous acetate, is an inorganic manganese salt used across industrial chemistry primarily as a catalyst and metal ion source. It delivers controlled manganese content in formulations and process baths where precise metal dosing determines product quality. In textile dyeing and leather finishing, it acts as a mordant and oxidation catalyst. This chemical improves dye fixation and surface uniformity in various industrial applications. Coatings and paint manufacturers use it as a drier catalyst to accelerate oxidative curing in alkyd and oil-based systems. In agriculture, it supplies manganese as a micronutrient in fertilizer formulations and foliar spray concentrates. This is particularly effective where manganese deficiency correction is the primary target outcome. Polymer and plastics producers incorporate it as a catalyst in polymerization and condensation reactions. This is essential in processes where transition metal activation is required for high-quality material production. Manganese diacetate is supplied as a crystalline powder or granules, with tetrahydrate form being the most commercially prevalent. Standard grades include technical and reagent-grade specifications for processing. Purity levels typically range from technical grade through high-purity grades suited for pharmaceutical and biotechnology use.
